title: Find case-insensitive keywords
goal: combines trim, case conversion and includes to implement substring search.
summary: device query allows entering part of the model number. Whitespace at both ends of the search term can be ignored, and an empty query displays all.
tasks: completes matchesKeyword(text, query) to find out whether text contains query after cleaning and ignoring case.
returns a Boolean value. Empty or plain whitespace queries return true.

example.note: includes determines whether there is a substring and returns true or false. Unify the capitalization on both sides before comparing.

hint: query must be trim() first, and both text and query must be converted to the same case.
